title: Eigenvalue optimization via a first-variation formula
summary: We compute the Clarke subdifferential of the $k$th eigenvalue functional on the space of self-adjoint operators, obtaining a first-variation formula that remains valid even when the eigenvalue lies at the edge of the essential spectrum. This formula provides an effective tool for describing the structure of critical points in eigenvalue optimization problems and can also yield simple proofs of the existence of optimizers.
